method: Reverse-DCF: solve for the constant annual FCF growth the current price implies. 10-yr explicit FCF + Gordon terminal; discount 10%, terminal growth 2.5%. value(g)=sum_i fcf*(1+g)^i/(1.10)^i + [fcf*(1+g)^10*1.025/0.075]/(1.10)^10; implied g solved by bisection so (value+netcash)/shares = price. FCF/shares/net-cash are real TTM figures (Q1 2026 / latest filings). Higher implied g = more growth already priced in.
